title: Beach Music | Beachside 30A Rental | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Beach Music is a chic coastal escape near Rosemary Beach, just steps from the Gulf, with a community pool, bikes, balcony views, and relaxed luxury.
description_expanded: Beach Music Features - Gated Neighborhood is adjacent to Seacrest Beach and Rosemary Beach - walk or bike to shopping and dining in 3 minutes - 8 min to the largest Publix in America - 5 Min to 30Avenues, with incredible shopping and dining. Check out daily Happy Hour at Amici 30A Italian Kitchen. The best Happy Hour on 30A - 150 Footsteps to Seacrest Beach Entrance - catch a glimpse of the Gulf from the balcony! - Community Gulf Front Pool one minute from the home - only available for guests staying in Sunset Beach - Enjoy 2 Taxi bikes, serviced regularly to ensure they are in top shape for your arrival - 1st Floor Laundry Room with stacked Washer/Dryer - Outdoor Gas Grill on the covered front porch - Covered patio with cushioned seating - WIFI and cable - Bluetooth Stereo - Smart TV in the living room - Driveway Parking for 2 cars - Dining table with seating for 6 - Full kitchen is well stocked for your meal prep needs - Fireplace is decorative - Strict No Pet Policy - neighborhood prohibits pets for guests - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee Escape the commotion of everyday life and join us for the most relaxing vacation get-a-away that you've ever experienced. Located beachside on Highway 30A in the gated community of Sunset Beach, Beach Music offers a vacation of a lifetime including a Gulf front community pool! Our two bedroom, three bath home is nestled a few blocks away from the prestigious and highly sought after destination of Rosemary Beach as well as famous Alys Beach. Decorated by our team of professional designers combines chic interiors and relaxed design for the ultimate getaway. Beach Music is an exquisitely decorated two-bedroom, three bath home approximately 150 steps from the Emerald Coast. Catch a glimpse of the Gulf from the balcony! The main level of Beach Music features a comfortable, tastefully decorated living room where guests can unwind in style! The furniture and accessories have been carefully and thoughtfully purchased to provide a tranquil coastal atmosphere.
rooms_guidance: 2nd Floor King Suite | TV, ceiling fan, private entrance to balcony, closet and dresser storage, ensuite bath with walk-in shower
2nd Floor Guest Room | 2 twin beds, TV, ceiling fan, private entrance to balcony, closet and dresser storage, adjacent to full bath
Bonus | Queen Sleeper Sofa in the 1st floor living room with nearby full bath featuring a combination shower/tub, dresser storage

Accessibility: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
Property Amenities: Path to Entrance Lit at Night
